how: Selected the first paragraphs of the Arabic Wikipedia article "القاهرة" (Cairo) and ran document.execCommand("copy").
notes: First paragraphs of the Arabic article: right-to-left text with Arabic diacritics, Latin text and digits mixed in; links percent-encode the Arabic titles (href="https://ar.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1"). The direction comes from the page (no dir attribute inside the fragment), so you must infer RTL from the text.
